PXFACE - 3×5 pixel wordmark renderer

PXFACE generates deterministic, editable pixel typography as SVG or PNG. It is a renderer, not a conventional font service.

Studio: https://pxface.com/
API guide: https://pxface.com/docs/api
JavaScript and React: https://pxface.com/docs/javascript
NPM package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/pxface
Source: https://github.com/gwendall/pxface
OpenAPI 3.1 contract: https://pxface.com/openapi.yaml
Agent skill: https://pxface.com/SKILL.md
License: https://pxface.com/license

Render endpoint: GET or POST https://pxface.com/api/v1/render
Formats: svg (default), png
Determinism: pass an integer seed with random colors or pixel effects
Pixel effects: spectrum, explode, wave, glitch, weave; tune with effectAmount
Per-pixel edits: POST pixelOverrides keyed by stable IDs such as l0-c0-r0-x0
Limits: 160 characters, 8 lines, 60 requests/minute/IP, 16384px/edge, 64 million pixels

For JavaScript, TypeScript, Node, React, SSR, or React Server Components, install `pxface`. Import the pure renderer from `pxface` or the optional server-compatible component from `pxface/react`. Both expose the same effects, resolved pixel scene, and canonical implementation as the hosted endpoint.

The 3×5 glyph shapes are CC0-1.0 with no attribution required. App source is MIT. PXFACE name and logo are excluded.
